recreation_brief: 1. Set the entire slide background to solid light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Draw the outer frame: one rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) outline (est. 1.5-2pt) and no contrasting fill, covering the full slide with a ~5% margin from every edge. 3. Draw the inner content box: one white (#FFFFFF) filled rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) outline (est. 1.5-2pt), centered on the slide and spanning approximately 8-92% of slide width and 18-88% of slide height. 4. Place the title: one centered text box inside the white rectangle (occupying roughly 30-75% of slide height) containing exactly three lines in this order — 'The Complete', 'Machine Learning', 'Classification Process' — set in bold sans-serif (e.g., Arial), very large (est. ~44-54pt), color #C00000, with wide line spacing. 5. Place the slide-number badge: one small yellow (#FFFF99) circle with a thin dark (#333333) outline at the top-right of the gray frame (centered around 90-95% horizontal, 5-10% vertical), with the number '29' centered inside in small dark (#333333) sans-serif text. 6. Add nothing else: no subtitle, no bullet list, no images, no footers; do not recreate the dark (#555555) mouse-cursor artifact above the title, which is a screen-recording artifact and not slide content.
